agentGuide:
Send: POST /emails {"from": "Name ", "to": ["..."], "subject": "...", "html": "

...

"} (or text; reply_to, cc, bcc, attachments as [{"filename", "content": base64}]); batch: POST /emails/batch [ {...}, {...} ]. One sent mail: GET /emails/ (last_event: delivered, bounced…). Domains: GET /domains (status verified or not); contacts and audiences: GET /audiences, GET /audiences//contacts, add: POST /audiences//contacts {"email": "..."}. Broadcasts: GET /broadcasts, POST /broadcasts, send: POST /broadcasts//send — asks for confirmation. API keys: GET /api-keys. The from address must be on a verified domain. The key is set by Allkin.
